SHENZHEN, China, Oct. 3, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Lanshan Robotics, a privately held maker of warehouse robots, signed a supply agreement on Friday with a logistics park backed by the Nanning Municipal People's Government.
The Publicity Department of the CPC Nanning Municipal Committee attended the signing, the company said.
Lanshan Robotics was founded in 2019 and employs 800 people.
